name: Smart Automations
source: Smart Automations Panel V1.0.0 exact + Suite layout runtime V1.0.0 + color-picker guard V1.0.0 + responsive runtime V1.0.0
frontend_source: Smart Automations Panel V1.0.0 + smart-automations-layout.js + smart-automations-runtime.js + smart-automations-responsive.js
layout_runtime_source: Adds category ordering, instance ordering and per-instance visual metadata through the existing Personalización working copy
color_picker_guard_source: Suppresses full Personalización rerenders during native color input events; normal change event performs preview render
responsive_runtime_source: Adapts only legacy 520px layout to tablet/desktop width, uses container queries with the existing mobile/tablet/desktop columns, keeps summary full width and leaves cards aligned from the left
migration: none; existing smart_automations.config remains valid and is never rewritten by the responsive runtime
native_automation_contract: unchanged; Home Assistant remains the automation execution engine and the responsive runtime is presentation-only
notes: No recipe, REST automation API, ownership/hash, selector, navigation, Personalización or storage behavior changes
